fullPassage: A study by Eva McMahan, professor of speech communication, confirmed the dominance of nonverbal signals. The phenomenon, however, was especially pronounced when adults found themselves in situations with conflicting messages (i.e., situations in which the contents of the verbal and nonverbal messages differ). Attempts to manipulate another person verbally are therefore likely to fail if the accompanying nonverbal communication does not match the spoken message. This is because people trust nonverbal messages more than verbal ones. When somebody tells you that they enjoy spending time with you, but you notice how they are looking away and are forcing a smile, you are probably less inclined to believe their words. The same is probably true when you are back at the office after a sickness and your colleague tells you with a smiling expression that they were happy to take over your workload. You might not believe that they enjoyed replacing you while you were gone.

questions.passage: A study by Eva McMahan, professor of speech communication, confirmed the dominance of nonverbal signals. The phenomenon, however, was especially pronounced when adults found themselves in situations with conflicting messages (i.e., situations in which the contents of the verbal and nonverbal messages differ). Attempts to manipulate another person verbally are therefore likely to fail if the accompanying nonverbal communication does not match the spoken message. This is because people trust nonverbal messages more than verbal ones. When somebody tells you that they enjoy spending time with you, but you notice how they are looking away and are forcing a smile, you are probably less inclined to believe their words. The same is probably true when you are back at the office after a sickness and your colleague tells you with a smiling expression that they were happy to take over your workload. You might not believe that they enjoyed replacing you while you were gone.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글의 핵심은 말보다 비언어적 신호가 더 강력하게 신뢰받는다는 것이므로 ④가 제목으로 적절해요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① How to Master the Art of Persuasive Speech(설득력 있는 말하기를 익히는 법): 말하기 기술이 주제가 아니에요

❌ ② Verbal Skills: The Key to Successful Manipulation(언어 기술, 성공적 조종의 열쇠): 본문은 오히려 언어적 조종이 실패한다고 했어요

❌ ③ Why Honesty Is the Best Workplace Policy(정직이 최선의 직장 방침인 이유): 정직을 권하는 글이 아니에요

✅ ④ When Actions Speak Louder: The Power of Nonverbal Signals(행동이 더 크게 말할 때: 비언어적 신호의 힘): 비언어가 말보다 신뢰받는다는 요지와 일치 ←정답
det.tip: actions speak louder than words(행동이 말보다 더 크게 말한다)라는 표현이 글의 핵심을 압축해요.
